description: A modular, stack-agnostic toolkit for AI coding agents to autonomously find, reproduce, and patch vulnerabilities.

written.description: Reads a codebase and its commit history, builds a threat model from them, and sends agents to chase each hypothesis it raises. It then tries to reproduce each finding in a sandbox and attacks its own patch to check the fix holds, working from source alone with no running target.

alive.last_commit_message:
feat(llm): Anthropic context editing for Claude models

Server-side clearing of a stage's older tool results (Anthropic's
context_management, edit clear_tool_uses). The provider applies it
before the model reads a request that has grown past the trigger, so a
long stage stays inside the window while the request we send remains
append-only -- the one form of history management that models binding
their reasoning to its prefix accept. The cleared results become a
placeholder the model can see, and the edit is reported back. Measured
on Vertex AI through LiteLLM: a 210,105-token request served at 529
tokens, both tool results reported cleared, the model saying so.

Claude models only, on any route; the parameter is Anthropic's and is
never built for another model. Trigger at half the window, so the
provider acts before the node context ceiling (0.8) and the ceiling
stays the backstop; the newest five tool results kept verbatim; at
least a fifth of the window cleared per edit, since each edit
invalidates the prompt cache from the edit point. Off with
context_editing: off in the workflow config or with
MANTIS_CONTEXT_EDITING=off, and not sent for a model whose window
litellm cannot report.

The client-side estimates now count the request the way the provider
reads it: the pre-dispatch guard replaces every tool result but the
kept ones with the placeholder before estimating, and the node context
ceiling does the same with the request's function responses. Without
that, both would refuse or end a stage the provider was about to serve.
A stage whose model carries the edit is told, in the same words on
every call, that older tool results may be cleared and to record what
it relies on through tools as it goes.

Tests: the parameter is built for Claude only, sized to the window,
switchable off, absent for an unknown window, and carried by
get_llm_kwargs for Claude and not for Gemini; the guard passes a
request the provider will clear and still refuses one whose kept
window alone cannot fit; the gateway hands the request's edit to the
guard; the ceiling measures as the provider reads and appends its
notice once per attempt.
